items.evidence: Applied to main 48f757c: local HTTP clients inherited environment proxies. HEAD 102b0af on audit-fixes disables inheritance in llm_client.py:56, vision.py:65, upload.py:74, tray.py:43 and upstream-added preflight.py:93. server.py:1091 preserves cloud-provider proxy behavior. LLM proxy and shutdown tests passed. Across two read-only test runs, 72 tests passed; file-writing integration tests were inspected but not run.

Applied to main: its splitter still assigned a single unlabelled block to step 1. The new guard returns an empty placement; the warning reports zero placed steps. Capture retains semantic rescue and photo mode preserves declined placements as verify claims at server.py:1166–1180. All transcript unit tests passed; added server integration tests were inspected.

Applied to main: narrative exceptions discarded text and narrative verify IDs were ignored. The helper now catches client construction/generation failures and invokes ensure_claim_coverage with placed_text. server.py:982–988 merges narrative verify IDs and claim text into the sidecar. Coverage and unchanged sidecar tests passed. The three named server tests exist and assert fallback text and report accounting; their filesystem writes prevented execution under READ-ONLY.

Applied to main: validate_claim_coverage received potentially None narrative text. Both coverage checks now normalize None to an empty string, and F-02 supplies failure fallback text. The failing-narrative integration test asserts completed generation and exported verify content. Caveat: the newly named no-claims test actually synthesizes claims from fixture steps, so it does not exercise its advertised empty-claims case. Integration tests were inspected, not executed.

Applied to main: export polish had no subsequent step round-trip or fallback protection. HEAD adds fallback restoration, capture round-trip validation, conditional claim preservation and polish_reverted_steps reporting; every exporter receives the guarded results. Tests cover dropped element names and fallback restoration. However, phases/DEVIATIONS.md documents exceptions to the agreed gate.
items.gap: The acceptance requirement for an unconditional post-polish round-trip/claim gate does not hold: photo jobs skip round_trip_ok, and capture jobs without a transcript disable step claim checks at line 1011. These are deliberate deviations, not upstream fixes making the entire finding moot. Integration tests were not run because they write files.

items.evidence: Applied to main: successful captions displaced transcript text without adding narration. Captioned steps now retain deterministic or semantic-alignment verbatim slices as narration; failed captions use transcript text without duplicate narration. Export polish restores photo narration at server.py:1344–1353. Added deterministic, semantic-rescue and export-polish tests verify these paths; inspected without running their filesystem writes.

Both review.py:25 and pages.py:761 render the category. The rendering test passed; photo integration tests cover one failed caption and disabled vision.
